theorem_title: Finite repetition bound for a positive initial value
natural_language_statement:
Let $a,b,k\in\mathbb N$, $\gcd(b,a)=1$, and $y:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ with $y_0>0$. If $b y_{i+1}=a y_i$ for every $i<k$, then

$$
b^k\le y_0.
$$

This bounds repetitions of one fixed multiplier; it imposes no common budget on changing multipliers.
